Or create a group and invite students with a shared link.
If you schedule a group lesson, every student in the group will get a notification. Group materials are available to all members

onboarding.createInvoice:
To get paid for a lesson, issue an invoice to the student.
If the student does not pay, you will not need to remind them: they will receive an automatic overdue payment notification

firstLessonGuide.title: Where to start
firstLessonGuide.description: We explain how to take the first steps on the sovlium platform

firstSteps.title: First steps
firstSteps.welcomeBody: We, the Sovlium team, prepared short interactive tasks. They take a little time and help you learn how work is organized here.
firstSteps.joinHelp: Ask your tutor for an invitation link and open it in this account. After you confirm, the classroom appears on its own and the step is checked off.

navigation.title: Learn the navigation
navigation.hint: The hint shows the sections, notifications, and profile menu, then collapses and expands the panel.

settings.title: Open settings
settings.hint: The hint opens the whole menu at the bottom, then shows Settings and the Help submenu.

cabinet.title: Look around the classroom
cabinet.hint: The hint opens Classrooms, shows the demo classroom, and the navigation inside it.

call.title: Start a call
call.hint: The video call starts from the classroom. The hint shows the button and waits for a click.

workspace.title: View the board and the note
workspace.hint: The classroom already has a demo board and a note. The hint opens both.
workspace.action: Open the board and the note

invite.title: Invite a student
invite.hint: Create a link and send it to your student so you can study together.

material.title: Prepare a material
material.hint: Create a board for working together or a note with the lesson plan.

lesson.title: Schedule a lesson
lesson.hint: Choose a student and set the time of the first lesson.
lesson.blocked: Invite a student first. You can schedule a lesson once a classroom exists.

join.title: Join a classroom
join.hint: Open the link from your tutor. If you do not have one yet, ask your tutor to send it.

classroom.title: Open the classroom
classroom.hint: This is where you will work with your tutor during lessons.
classroom.blocked: Open your tutor’s invitation link first. The classroom appears after you join.

schedule.title: Check the schedule
schedule.hint: The lesson date and time will show up here once your tutor schedules it.
